title: What are the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department
question: What are the minimum number of enrolled students and the average department budget code for each department, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department is degree granting, the department last activity date is after '01-JAN-90', and the department is Mathematics? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    MIN(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students,
    AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_department_budget_code
FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED s
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE > '01-JAN-90'
  AND (s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10 OR d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y')

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON c.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.COURSE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = c.COURSE_LEVEL WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH school_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS AS min_total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT
